title: Rutherford's Atomic Model — The Alpha-Particle Scattering Experiment
notes: **Experiment:** positively charged helium ions (α-particles) were fired at an ultra-thin gold foil
**Observation:** most α-particles passed straight through, undeflected
**Conclusion:** atoms are mostly empty space, with a tiny, dense, positively charged core called the **nucleus**
